sections.title: Before reading: study Chapter 8 in How to read. A dry shelf is small

segments.text: 人持卷，寧視帙。人在屋內，門閉。屋內有火，火明。屋有架，架乾。架下有水，架上無水。
客：「架在何處？」
segments.speaker: char-visitor

segments.text: 人指門後。
人：「架在門後。」
segments.speaker: char-reader

segments.text: 安持燈，至架前。寧在架後，客在架前。客不出門，持書。人持此束，客持彼束。架在兩束間，燈在兩束間。
安移燈。燈在架上，安視卷。人至架前，寧至兩束間。人在左，客在右。寧先視印，安別兩束。此束有卷，彼束有書。書在帙中。客視紙，紙有姓。人視帙，寧視卷。
人：「此帙壞。卷濕。」
segments.speaker: char-reader

segments.text: 寧視帙，安視葉。人指此葉，安視葉。此葉在下。人指彼葉，寧視葉。彼葉在上。
卷有葉。架下有水，葉濕。人視葉，寧視字。葉有字，帙有印。人視字，不讀卷。寧指卷，安視架。架小，架上有燈。人持卷，卷在架下。
人：「架上無處。」
segments.speaker: char-reader

sections.title: Moving the lamp makes room to preserve the lower leaves

segments.text: 安移燈，持燈。燈在手，安視架。架上無燈，寧視卷。人還卷，寧取卷。人持帙，寧持卷。帙有印，卷有全葉。安先視葉，寧不出門。寧指此葉，安視葉。此葉在下，彼葉在上。寧不取書，客持書。
寧移卷，存卷。卷在架上，人持帙。人移帙。帙在架下，卷在架上。人持帙，視卷。

sections.title: The book is protected, but the incoming water continues

segments.text: 人持帙，至門後。人開門，視雨。門前有雨，門後有水。屋漏，水入屋。人不出門，閉門。安持燈，寧視卷。卷在架上，寧待人。人還，持帙。
人：「屋外有雨。屋內有水。」
segments.speaker: char-reader

segments.text: 客視紙，紙乾。寧視卷，人視帙。卷在架上，帙在架下。安不移卷，持燈。
客開帙，移紙。紙在帙中，書在帙中。客閉帙，持彼束。客存紙，紙不壞。寧視印，人持帙。此帙濕，彼帙乾。安視此帙，寧視卷。屋漏，架下有水。卷不在架下，寧不移卷。客持彼束，紙在帙中。寧不取紙，人不取書。
人視架上，寧視架下。架上有卷，架下有水。安持燈，燈在手。人持帙，帙壞。客持彼束，紙在帙中。寧存卷，人待寧。安指水，客視門。門閉，屋漏。水入屋，架上有水。寧視葉，人視水。

cover.alt: The travellers face a wet fascicle and a small dry shelf.

grammar.title: 卷在架上，水在架下。
grammar.rule: 架｜上；架｜下；門｜前；門｜後；兩束｜間。
grammar.note_en:
Study Chapter8 in How to read before reading. The cards introduce the room, shelf and positional expressions before the four retrieval packets. All24 packet attempts and18 additional earlier-meaning retrievals supplement the normal workbook and Pensa. Tone-marked Mandarin pinyin remains a citation-reading aid, not reconstructed Classical sound.

A locative expression names a place or position. Put a named object first and its position word after it: 架上 means on or above the shelf, 架下 below the shelf, 架前 in front of it and 架後 behind it. In 架下有水，架上無水, “There is water below the shelf, none on it,” the location precedes familiar having/existence predicates. In 燈在架上, “The lamp is on the shelf,” 在 precedes the complete shelf-plus-position phrase. No verb climb, lower or put up is encoded by 上 or 下.

屋 wū names the current near-gate reading house/room, not the far-away family household or an added roof word. 人在屋內 means “The person is inside the room.” 屋外有雨 means “There is rain outside the building.” 內 and 外 retain their earlier meanings, now following other named anchors as well as 門. The guest’s 架在何處？ “Where is the shelf?” receives 架在門後 “The shelf is behind the door.” This is a genuine question about a new room’s storage location. For this door, front is its outside approach and back its interior side; the shelf’s front faces An in the current inspection. Track each named anchor instead of making front or back a permanent compass direction.

兩束間 means between the two bundles, using the previously practised two-bundle count. In 架在兩束間，燈在兩束間, “The shelf and lamp are between the two bundles,” those objects occupy the middle region while the two holders are separated. 寧至兩束間 means “Ning reaches the space between the bundles.” The citation reading is jiān here. A complete location phrase can name a destination after 至, an object pointed to after 指, or the region looked at after 視: 人指門後 “The person points behind the door,” 人視架上 “The person looks at the shelf’s upper area.” The whole location phrase names one region.

Be careful about two reference frames. 此葉在下，彼葉在上 means “This leaf is lower, that one upper,” within the open fascicle. Moving the whole fascicle onto the shelf puts its leaves on the shelf; their internal order need not change. The later 此葉在架上 names the shelf explicitly. These are leaves in this reader’s fascicle, not the father’s old loose leaves. No leaf is plucked out. The writing remains unsupplied; looking at its characters does not decode an unread name.

移 yí takes the moved object directly. 安移燈, “An moves the lamp,” is followed by 燈在架上, “The lamp is on the shelf.” Later 安移燈，持燈。燈在手 means “An moves the lamp and holds it; it is in his hand.” The explicit holder supplies the familiar hand reference. 寧移卷 followed by 卷在架上, “Ning moves the fascicle; it is on the shelf,” states the result separately, without a new complex goal complement. The reader retains and lowers the wet wrapper, while the fascicle and its leaves stay on the shelf. Mark on wrapper and writing within the volume are distinct locations.

架上無處 has a bounded availability interpretation: no placing-spot is available on the shelf for the waiting material. 處 still means place; this does not deny that an occupied surface exists. First the lamp occupies the small shelf. Removing it allows the fascicle onto the shelf, after which no space remains for the other bundle. 架小 alone or saying the other book is not there would not establish this capacity limit. The clause describes available space; 存 means preserve and does not state capacity.

存 cún means preserve or retain material from further harm. 寧存卷，安存葉 describes their cooperative preservation: An frees the shelf by moving the lamp, and Ning relocates the fascicle with its lower leaves. The guest later encloses his sheet in his case: 客存紙, “The guest preserves the sheet.” It does not mean can contain or instant recovery. 壞 huài is damaged, not necessarily destroyed. The wrapper is damaged; the exposed leaves are still not damaged, and the sheet is protected. Wetness and damage are related in this scene but are not universal synonyms.

漏 lòu is physical leakage. 屋漏，水入屋 means “The building leaks; water enters the room.” Water is the subject of the familiar entering action. The surrounding water and rain select physical seepage here. 雨 yǔ is the noun rain. The reader opens the same near door, sees rain, stays inside and closes it before returning and reporting rain outside. Later fresh ingress and water on the shelf show the threat continues. Nothing instantly dries, and temporary protection is not a guarantee of permanent safety.

At the end the reader has the wet marked wrapper, the fascicle rests on the shelf under Ning’s immediate care, An holds the borrowed lamp, and the messenger keeps the dry large book with the surname sheet now enclosed in its case. These are explicit changed positions and handoffs, not ownership findings. The family, teacher, old loose leaves, mother’s small book and original An sheet remain far home. All four remain inside the near room/door; only a brief opening, observation and closure occur.

B.title: Retrieve positions, objects, actions and conditions

obrazec.rule: Use the unchanged form selected by each numbered meaning and citation cue. The bank mixes word classes: unused spatial, noun, verb and quality alternatives remain. Worked example: on the shelf, shàng. Separate miniature incidents, not extra story facts. Type the unchanged studied Chinese form selected by each numbered meaning and citation cue. Numbered cues: 1: between the two bundles, jiān; 2: shelf, jià; 3: house or room, wū; 4: rain as a noun, yǔ; 5: moves the lamp, yí; 6: leaks, lòu; 7: preserves the sheet, cún; 8: is damaged, huài.

C.title: Pensa C — Follow the material and the changing positions
C.instruction: Continue each cue or answer its question in complete Chinese statements, retrieving a consequence or contrast beyond the cue. No bare name, yes/no, invented water source, owner or absent household transfer. Models are examples for self checking.

model_answers: 架上無處。人持卷，卷在架下。
items.rubric: Retrieve the lack of an available placing-spot and/or the waiting volume’s position, not merely name the lamp. No ability verb or claim that the shelf does not exist.

model_answers: 人還卷，寧取卷。寧移卷，存卷。卷在架上。
items.rubric: Retrieve the handoff and changed volume position that follows removal of the lamp. Moving is not instant drying.

model_answers: 卷在架上，葉在架上。架下有水。葉不壞。
items.rubric: Track the same fascicle’s leaves to the shelf, separating internal lower-leaf order from their new position relative to the shelf. Do not import family loose leaves or remove a leaf.

items.prompt: 客持彼束，至架前。架、書、客：
model_answers: 架上有卷，架上無處。書乾。客不移書，持彼束。
items.rubric: Explain the remaining capacity limit and the guest’s choice to keep his dry book held; merely saying the other book is absent is insufficient.

model_answers: 人不出門，閉門。屋外有雨，屋內有水。
items.rubric: Retrieve door closure and remaining inside/no exit and/or inside/outside contrast, without guessing a new journey, roof noun or time word.

model_answers: 紙在帙中。卷在架上。門閉，屋漏。水入屋，架上有水。
items.rubric: Retrieve enclosed sheet and/or renewed water threat after the volume’s temporary protection. Do not claim all wet material is now dry or permanently safe.

Room names the existing near-gate reading interior, not a return home or an unmentioned second journey. Lower leaves belong to this opened reader-fascicle; current case/shelf/paper changes are explicit.
